decided_by: Devin (implementation agent) implementing owner-approved F-E001 governance
decision: Correct F-E001 convergence diagnostic: SE of (batch - pooled) is sqrt(3)*SE_pool for n_b=B/4; quantile checks moved to CDF-space bracket test robust to discrete/atomic statistics
rationale: The frozen v1 criterion compared batch-pooled deviations to 4*SE_pool. Var(m_b - m_pool) = 3*SE_pool^2 when batches are B/4, making v1 a ~2.3-sigma test that produced ~94 spurious NOT CONVERGED flags, and value-space quantile comparison cannot represent integer-quantile granularity. Correction affects CONVERGENCE REPORTING ONLY: generated fair draws, statistic values, exact baselines, and validation are unchanged (same frozen streams; determinism probes re-verify identical draws).
alternatives_considered: Keep v1 and relabel mass failures as PASS (rejected: dishonest); rerun with different seeds (rejected: seed-shopping); increase replicates (rejected: waste, does not fix formula)
notes: Superseding config config/experiments/F-E001.v2.yaml + amendment doc research/preregistrations/F-E001-amendment-01-convergence-se.md; convergence.py implements v2.

decided_by: Devin (implementation agent) under research-lead corrective gate
decision: Document and govern the shared-history Monte Carlo stream scope actually implemented: "<game>|<statistical_regime>|HISTORIES|batch<b>"
rationale: Frozen F-E001 text specified child-stream scope "game|statistical_regime|statistic_id|batch". Implementation instead derives ONE fair-history stream per (game, statistical regime, batch) and computes F-S001..F-S013 from the same replicate histories. Statistically valid: every statistic still receives 20,000 iid fair histories with correct marginal null distribution, and shared histories preserve the natural joint dependence among statistics that will later be compared together. Also avoids 13x redundant simulation. Discrepancy found in research-lead Phase 2 audit at f7ccf64; no historical winning-number outcomes had been analyzed and the choice was not selected for any historical result. No marginal statistic value depends on this choice.
alternatives_considered: Per-statistic streams (rejected: 13x cost for identical marginal distributions and destroys joint dependence); leave undocumented (rejected: frozen text must match implementation).

The production implementation overwrote the first position of each segment with a boundary sentinel (md[seg_starts]=True / ms[seg_starts]=False), shortening any run beginning at a segment start by 1 and reporting 0 for a 1-draw segment. alternatives_considered: Change definitions to match buggy implementation (rejected: definitions were correct); leave uncorrected (rejected: silently wrong baselines).
